notes: - Fix: 15S and 4H SNIPER: "weak rejection" is an AVOID rule in their texts, so it is now an AVOID rule (a Settings switch, on by default) instead of a mandatory confirmation. Mandatory confirmations are now exactly the items the texts call mandatory or "must agree": 5S sweep + BOS + candle, 15S sweep + BOS + candle, 5M HTF trend + BOS + candle, 15M HTF trend + sweep + BOS + candle, 1M / 1H / 4H the HTF trend, 30S and 30M none.
